engineChanges.summary: Preserve a focused link AX name when a saved generated pseudo glyph in the link subtree is confirmed by the AX focused link name and matching URL.
Adds a focused positive case plus negative controls for DOM-only pseudo metadata, textual pseudo content, and URL-mismatched AX nodes.
Regenerated extension runtime bundle from the engine source change.

implementedRule.genericCause: AX-confirmed generated pseudo glyphs in link names
guards: descriptor name must come from link content, not aria-label or aria-labelledby
saved link subtree must expose a generated pseudo token
pseudo token must be short, non-alphanumeric, and non-whitespace
AX node must uniquely match the DOM node as a focusable link
AX URL path/search must match the link href
AX name compactly equals descriptor content name plus the pseudo token
notImplemented: No site selectors, Apple class names, product names, URLs, or text-copy assumptions.
No synthesis from DOM pseudo metadata without AX confirmation.
No broad textual pseudo suffix handling.
